objective: Aislar exclusivamente la consulta Q03-PERSONA-LINK-POPULATION que formaba parte del sql_readonly_audit de Gate12J-R2. Ejecutar una sola consulta READ_ONLY_SQL. No modificar codigo, SQL, RBAC, secrets, workflows ni Produccion. No avanzar a Gate12K.

queries.name: q03_persona_link_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_sin_persona,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_con_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;
